en.title: XRP Price Plummets After News
en.summary: XRP's probability of exceeding $1.40 has dropped to 0% following an 18.4% price decline. This movement was primarily driven by negative market reactions to the Pepeto SoftBank partnership announcement.
drivers: XRP price fell 18.4% in 24 hours
Pepeto SoftBank partnership announcement
Overall bearish sentiment in the crypto market
en.why_matters: This decline reflects broader market instability and investor uncertainty, impacting XRP's future price trajectory.
en.bull_case: If positive developments arise from the Pepeto partnership, XRP could regain investor confidence and rise above $1.40.
en.bear_case: Continued negative sentiment in the crypto market could further depress XRP prices, keeping them below $1.40.

zh.title: XRP价格大幅下跌

drivers: XRP价格在24小时内下跌18.4%
Pepeto与软银的合作公告
整体加密市场的悲观情绪
zh.why_matters: 这一下跌反映了更广泛的市场不稳定和投资者的不确定性，影响XRP的未来价格走势。
zh.bull_case: 如果Pepeto合作带来积极进展，XRP可能恢复投资者信心，超过1.40美元。

en.title: China GDP Growth Outlook Dims
en.summary: China's GDP growth probability dropped to 1% after export growth slowed significantly. Key drivers include a 2.5% export growth in March and geopolitical uncertainties from the Iran war.
drivers: 2.5% export growth in March
Geopolitical uncertainty from Iran war
Industrial growth at 6.3% year-on-year
en.why_matters: Slowing exports and geopolitical tensions could hinder China's economic recovery, impacting global markets.
en.bull_case: If industrial growth continues robustly, GDP could exceed 4.5% despite export challenges.
en.bear_case: Continued export slowdown and geopolitical tensions may push GDP growth below 4.0%.

zh.title: 中国GDP增长前景暗淡
zh.summary: 中国GDP增长概率降至1%，因出口增长显著放缓。主要驱动因素包括3月出口增长2.5%和伊朗战争带来的地缘政治不确定性。
drivers: 3月出口增长2.5%
伊朗战争带来的地缘政治不确定性
工业增长年同比6.3%
zh.why_matters: 出口放缓和地缘政治紧张可能阻碍中国经济复苏，影响全球市场。
zh.bull_case: 如果工业增长持续强劲，尽管面临出口挑战，GDP可能超过4.5%。
zh.bear_case: 持续的出口放缓和地缘政治紧张可能导致GDP增长低于4.0%。
